exerciseInstructions.quadSet: Lie on your back, legs straight and resting on the floor. Without moving the leg, tighten your thigh muscle hard, pressing the back of the knee into the floor, hold for a few seconds, then relax.
exerciseInstructions.heelSlide: Lie on your back, legs straight. Slowly slide your heel towards your buttocks, bending the knee as far as you can without severe pain, then straighten the leg again.
exerciseInstructions.straightLegRaise: Lie on your back, propped up on your forearms. Lock the knee by tightening the thigh, raise the straight leg to about 45°, then lower it slowly.
exerciseInstructions.terminalKneeExt: Standing, band behind the front knee, anchored in front of you. Start with the knee slightly bent, then fully straighten it, pushing against the band.
exerciseInstructions.bodyweightSquat: Standing, feet hip-width apart. Lower yourself by pushing your hips back, knees in line with your feet, then come back up by pushing through your heels.
exerciseInstructions.wallSit: With your back against the wall, slide down to a height that stays comfortable for the knee and hold the position, breathing calmly.
exerciseInstructions.gluteBridge: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet on the floor. Lift your hips by squeezing your glutes, then lower slowly.
exerciseInstructions.bandedClamshell: Lie on your side, band just above the knees, knees bent and feet together. Open the top knee without rolling your pelvis, then close it slowly.
exerciseInstructions.deadBug: Lie on your back, arms reaching up to the ceiling, hips and knees at 90°. Slowly extend one arm and the opposite leg without lifting your lower back, then return and switch sides.
exerciseInstructions.birdDog: On all fours, back flat. Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back without arching, then return and switch sides.
exerciseInstructions.catCow: On all fours. Round your back towards the ceiling, tucking your chin, then gently arch it as you lift your head. Alternate slowly.
exerciseInstructions.codman: Lean forward with one hand on a table, the other arm hanging loose. Let it swing gently like a pendulum.
exerciseInstructions.bandExternalRotation: Elbow bent at 90° and tucked against your side, band in hand. Rotate the forearm outwards without lifting the elbow, then return slowly.
exerciseInstructions.wallSlides: Facing the wall, forearms against it. Slide them upwards, keeping your shoulders down, then lower them.
exerciseInstructions.chinTuck: Sit up straight. Tuck your chin by drawing your head straight back, as if making a double chin, and hold for a few seconds.
exerciseInstructions.singleLegCalfRaise: Stand on one leg, one hand against the wall. Rise up on your toes as high as you can, then lower slowly.
exerciseInstructions.plank: Resting on your forearms and toes, body in line from ankles to head. Hold the position while breathing.
exerciseInstructions.singleLegStance: Standing, hands on hips. Lift one foot and balance on the other leg, knee slightly unlocked.

patientInstructions.gluteBridge: Lie on your back, knees bent, lift your hips by squeezing your glutes, then lower slowly.
patientInstructions.bodyweightSquat: Standing, feet hip-width apart, gently bend your knees without letting them go past your toes.
patientInstructions.straightLegRaise: Lie on your back, propped up on your forearms, the other leg flat on the floor. Tighten the thigh to lock the knee, then raise the straight leg to about 45° without bending the knee. Lower it slowly.
patientInstructions.terminalKneeExt: Standing, one foot in front of the other, band behind the front knee and anchored in front of you at knee height. Start with the knee slightly bent, then fully straighten it, pushing back against the band. Return slowly.
